steps: Organize source recordings, reference material and editable exports.
Verify the available editing tools with reproducible local evidence.
Derive a scoped style guide from concrete references, including timing, image, type and sound coverage.

method.instruction: Use the guide as scoped editorial knowledge. Missing audiovisual coverage and unsupported operations remain explicit.
